did.abstract: This collection reflects the history of the Polytechnic Athletics Department circa 1880 to 2014.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The Poly archives were inventoried in 2011. Series I through Series IV were part of the collection, although they were unprocessed. Following the merger with NYU in 2014, Series V through Series IX were transferred to the Poly Archives after the closure of the Poly Athletics Department.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: This collection is arranged by format into nine series:

Series I: Poly athletics binders Series II: Athletics photo boxes Series III: Athletics media guides Series IV: Miscellaneous sports documentation Series V: Records, memorabilia, master schedule book Series VI: Plaques Series VII: Trophy case Series VIII: Jerseys and athletic wear Series IX: Oversized photographs.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: The Brooklyn Polytechnic Institute opened in 1854, and its administration initially prohibited sports teams from using the school's name. Despite this restriction, Poly students began organizing their own athletic clubs in the early 1880s. Football and baseball were among the earliest teams. The president of Poly, David Cochran, knew of these student-run clubs and chose to look the other way because they were not officially affiliated with the school. In 1887, however, considerable football injuries prompted him to ban the sport on campus. About a decade later, the administration established the first athletics committee, marking the beginning of officially recognized school sports at Poly. The collection covers both varsity and club sports throughout the twentieth century. The Poly Athletics Department and all associated DIII sports were dissolved following the merger with NYU in 2014.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Identification of item, date; Poly Athletics Department Records; RG 067; box number; folder number or item identifier; Poly Archives at Bern Dibner Library of Science and Technology, New York University.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Items from Series I and Series II were not rehoused, though they should be in the future. Items from Series IV that had sustained water damage and were not relevant to Poly athletics were separated. Series III through Series V were rehoused into acid free boxes and folders.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains materials produced by or related to the Polytechnic Athletics Department. These include documents, photos, posters, banners, trophies, plaques, game balls, jerseys, and other memorabilia.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Any rights (including copyright and related rights to publicity and privacy) held by Polytechnic University in all its forms are maintained by New York University. Permission to publish or reproduce materials in this collection must be secured from the Poly Archives. Please contact the Poly Archives, polyarchives@nyu.edu, 646-997-3530.
